entries.title: Fixed Stave-Basket Screw Press
entries.description: One newly authored whole static farm fruit-press appearance: two timber uprights and a thick truly bored top crossbeam carry a fixed vertical spindle with visible coarse helical thread and a transverse wood handle. A separate round pressure platen lies inside a genuinely open slatted stave basket held by two full annular hoops. Below it a shallow collector floor, partial raised rim and connected open U spout form a visible unfilled tray on the grounded timber base. Complete new construction, not a resized closed barrel, nested textile basket, flat-jaw bench vise or lever citrus press. No old visible meshes are imported or extracted. Closed editable meshes and three opaque constant PBR materials; small fixed embedded junctions. Metres, Z up and actual whole horizontal bounds centre, base underside Z0. Empty static game-art only: no fruit, liquid, pressing stroke, thread engagement, pressure, juice yield, food contact/hygiene, manufacture, stability or real-equipment safety certification.

entries.title: Mirror and Sample Fitting Corner
entries.description: One static fitting-preparation corner from the original tailoring scene program. A complete supported hollow long-sleeve lapel sample, a complete fixed full-length floor mirror, and a complete rail with its original hooked shoulder hanger form three separate display stations with an empty area in front of the mirror. All three existing asset IDs preserve every whole mesh, original local POSITION/NORMAL payload, material and internal hierarchy. Only unit-scale whole-instance translations and one finite scene-only floor are new. One scene and zero new independent models. No person, worn garment, body-size fit, cloth motion, changing enclosure, privacy guarantee, ergonomics, access or safety certification. The mirror remains the original ordinary metallic-roughness PBR surface; no runtime planar-reflection or optical accuracy claim.

entries.title: Three-Piece Nested-Channel Mine Arch Support
entries.description: One newly authored complete static mine-arch support module: two whole curved open U-channel legs on flat ground plates and one genuinely narrower open-channel crown nested into their grooves over two finite lap zones. Four front bridge straps with eight fixed hex-head appearances mark the actual lap locations. The crown back web meets the leg channel back-web plane; side clearances remain real. Every channel is a complete closed thick material shell around a truly open front groove, not a solid arch painted with lines or a reused stone arch with different colors. All seventeen component meshes newly authored with mature polygon-sweep primitives. The passage has no threshold, wall, rock lining or hidden blocker. Static art only: no moving adjustment, sliding mechanism, excavation, tunnel installation, structural strength, rock-load resistance, bolt tightening or mining safety claim.

entries.title: Folded Museum Label Holder
entries.description: One original independent tabletop museum label holder from the original museum label-holder candidate. One continuous thick folded profile joins a full floor base, rear vertical return, inclined reading face and integral short upturned front lip, leaving the entire underside open at the front and both sides. One separate complete blank label plate rests along the reading face. Two editable closed meshes and two constant opaque PBR materials, metres, Z up, front -Y. Newly authored continuous fold and blank insert, not a resized cabinet lectern, tripod music stand or a label detached from a plinth. Blank plate carries no writing or scientific specimen data. Fixed static geometry only; no folding, paper retention, item fit, load, strength, conservation, manufacturing or safety claim.

entries.title: Opposed Fractured Frozen Riverbanks
entries.description: One static frozen-riverbank cutaway scene. Two complete unchanged thick undercut fractured ice-edge assets face one another across a genuinely empty narrow bank-to-bank gap, above a flat opaque blue frozen-river base. Two whole snowbank modules sit on scene-only raised north and south ground strips; their ground-strip tops align with the full ice-edge upper surfaces. Four whole rigid unit-scale instances of two published models, one scene preset and zero new independent models. Not the old flowing woodland stream recolored: no stream meshes, rocks, fungi or trees are imported, and the wide fractured ice shelves, genuine V notches and deep underside ledges remain intact. No flowing water, weather, ice strength, walking route, load or safety certification.

entries.title: Broad-Disc Bent-Stem Sunflower
entries.description: One newly authored whole stylised sunflower crop appearance: a slightly bent stem supports a broad forward-inclined dark shallow-domed flower disc within a thick green receptacle and a ring of individually thick folded pointed golden ray petals. Two genuinely serrated cordate leaves with finite upper/lower surfaces grow from separate bent petioles. Not an extracted old planter flower, recolored maize or a petal-count variant: the complete head volume, elongated folded rays, backing and broad notched serrated leaf construction are newly authored. Metres Z up, true whole XY bounds-centred, stem-base sole at Z0; opaque PBR, no alpha cards. One static prop, no scenery. No botanical species/cultivar precision, counted seeds, growth, yield, wind/animation, ecology, physical stability or food-use claims.

entries.title: Static S-Curved Snake
entries.description: One original stylised limbless snake-inspired animal, with a broad slightly raised flattened head, narrowed neck, one long variable-thickness body following two opposite S bends and a fine tapering tail. Head, neck, body and tail are one continuous closed shared-vertex mesh; two small dark lateral eyes and one small thick forked tongue are separately editable complete meshes with visible seated roots. The tongue has an actual open V notch between its two tips, not a painted line. A pale belly is assigned to the lower faces of the same full body, with finite flat ground facets; it is not a second overlapping skin. All whole-path coordinates, section proportions, head, taper and tongue outline are newly authored. Not the old mooring rope given eyes, an octopus arm extracted, a snail without its shell, or a stretched tadpole. Only generic mesh orientation, ear clipping, eye primitive and mature export/render tools are reused. Four closed meshes, four opaque matte untextured PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, head/front -Y, full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One prop, zero scenes or extra poses. Artistic fixed exterior only: no real species, scale-row pattern, internal skeleton, biological anatomy, venom or dangerousness identification, mouth motion, sensing, locomotion, slithering simulation, rig, animation, collision, welfare or ecological performance claim.
